BrochureContent.Content: Welcome to Number 33 Wellfield a simply magnificent recently built `A` rated 4 bedroom semi-detached family home with the added benefit of over looking a picturesque green area to the front. Built to an exceptionally high standard, viewers will be instantly impressed upon entering the house by the considerable style and character which complements the well proportioned light filled living rooms. There is an abundance of living space with a generous size living room and a fantastic open plan kitchen / living / dining area, a utility room & a guest w.c, completes the ground floor accommodation. There are 4 generous size double bedrooms with master en-suite along with a family bathroom and home office on first floor level. Further features include a fully fitted kitchen and utility room, porcelain floor tiles, Air to water heat pump with under floor heating on ground floor level, double glazed windows, a large gravel driveway to the front and a 18 meter long rear garden. Ideally located within this exclusive development of only 47 houses, Wellfield is just a short walk from Malahide castle while the centre of Malahide village with its abundance of boutiques, cafes, restaurants and bars is also within close proximity. Viewing comes highly recommended.
